title: GateHub Euro (EURGH): Dinaro-issued MiCA EMT on XRPL and Xahau with SEPA wallet rails
purpose: Primary-source institutional, regulatory and payment-rail reconciliation. Distinguishes the regulated issuer, wallet/distribution partner, ledger deployment and any unproven XRP market-demand effect.
hash_scope: SHA-256 digests below cover normalized excerpt strings recorded in this artifact, not full source-page bytes or HTTP wire responses. The Dinaro white-paper link was found in GateHub's announcement but its content was not text-retrievable in this run.

event_summary.stated_redemption: at par, subject to legal and verification requirements
event_summary.stated_rails: SEPA deposits and redemptions from XRPL/Xahau wallet UX to European IBANs
event_summary.claimed_payment_speed: GateHub describes transfers to European IBANs as occurring in seconds; this is an issuer/partner claim, not an independently measured settlement SLA.

source_records.normalized_excerpt:
5 November 2026
GateHub Ltd. has partnered with Dinaro d.o.o., an authorised electronic money institution (EMI) and principal Mastercard issuer, to launch GateHub Euro (EURGH), a euro-denominated electronic money token (EMT), commonly referred to as a euro stablecoin, issued by Dinaro in accordance with the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA).
GateHub users can now make instant SEPA payments directly from their XRPL and Xahau wallets to any european IBAN in a matter of seconds.
limitations: GateHub is a launch partner and its speed, user-count and product claims are not independent operational measurements.
The same published issuer address for XRPL and Xahau does not establish identical balances or state on the two separate ledgers.
No circulating supply, issuance history, on-ledger volume, exchange listing or market depth was disclosed in the launch announcement.

source_records.normalized_excerpt:
Under MiCAR, e-money tokens are electronic money; they reference one official currency, do not grant interest, and holders have a claim against the issuer.
Entities intending to offer EMTs to the public or seek admission to trading must first obtain authorisation as an electronic money institution or a bank.
Issuers must notify Banka Slovenije at least 40 working days before the offer/admission and at least 20 working days before publication of the crypto-asset white paper.
limitations: This is general regulatory guidance, not a product-specific approval or endorsement of EURGH.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: Dinaro, as the Issuer, shall issue EURGH e-money tokens at par value at a ratio of 1:1 to the euro. EURGH Holders shall have a claim against Dinaro as issuer. All funds of EURGH Holders shall be safeguarded in accordance with MiCA. At the request of a EURGH Holder, Dinaro shall redeem the monetary value at par value and free of charge. EURGH has not been approved by any competent authority in any EU Member State; Dinaro is solely responsible for the contents of the terms.
limitations: The full white paper was linked by GateHub but returned no extractable text in this run; reserve composition, attestations, concentration limits and detailed redemption mechanics remain unverified here.

source_records.normalized_excerpt: The Xahau Ledger (Xahau) is the smart-contract sidechain for the XRPL ecosystem and a fork of the XRP Ledger's open-source rippled codebase. Xahau's native token is XAH; transaction fees and account reserves are charged in XAH.

network_and_xrp_relevance.xrp_fee_or_reserve_effect: Potential XRP fee/reserve demand is confined to the XRPL deployment; Xahau transaction fees and account reserves use XAH. Neither deployment establishes XRP as the bridge asset for the EUR-to-SEPA flow.
network_and_xrp_relevance.interpretation: EURGH is a euro-denominated claim against Dinaro, distributed through GateHub and connected to SEPA. XRPL deployment may create ordinary XRP fee/reserve use, but Xahau uses XAH, not XRP. The launch does not establish XRP as the bridge asset for the fiat flow or prove incremental XRP market demand.

competing_hypotheses.claim: EURGH may increase XRPL payment activity through euro mint/redeem and wallet-to-SEPA flows.
supporting: GateHub says users can fund and redeem EURGH through SEPA from XRPL/Xahau wallet interfaces.
disconfirming_or_missing: No circulating supply, daily issuance/redemption, transaction count, transfer volume, active-wallet or liquidity data captured.
The white paper and operational settlement metrics were not retrievable.
Xahau activity must not be conflated with XRPL activity.

competing_hypotheses.claim: EURGH launch could create direct XRP demand.
supporting: XRPL transactions require network resources and may use XRP for fees/reserves.
disconfirming_or_missing: GateHub's SEPA flow is described as EUR-to-EURGH and EURGH-to-SEPA; no XRP bridge-asset step is stated.
No issuer XRP holdings, market purchases, liquidity-provider commitments or XRP-denominated volume disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Dinaro's existing EMI authorisation and EEA passporting support the issuer's regulatory capacity.
supporting: Banka Slovenije lists Dinaro as an authorised EMI from 2021-11-02 and lists host-state activity.
Banka Slovenije's EMT guidance requires an EMI or bank authorisation.
disconfirming_or_missing: The official product terms state that the EURGH white paper has not been approved by an EU competent authority.
Product-specific reserve composition and operational controls were not independently retrieved.

reasons: A corporate/product launch is an event, not a measured market feature.
No issuance, redemption, circulating supply, reserve or ledger-activity series is available.
No evidence establishes an XRP bridge-asset requirement or XRP market purchases.
The white paper is not extractable in this run.

forecast.reason: This is a product/rail launch event with no measured usage or price-response sample. It cannot support a directional XRP forecast.
